narrative.overview:
A quiet pale lavender application shell gives the actual Live2D character visual priority. Dark ink, purple actions, white conversation surfaces, and compact outline icons carry the interface across browser and desktop panels.

The name below describes the approved lavender companion direction; it is documentation language, not an additional user-approved brand concept. This records the implemented system in ui/style.css, ui/index.html, ui/studio.js, and desktop/studio.py.
keyCharacteristics: Pale lavender foundations with purple interaction states.
Outfit typography with compact controls and restrained headings.
White rounded panels and circular avatar actions.
Actual model assets, spoken subtitles, and shared web panel styling.

rules.name: The Accent Signals Action Rule
rules.body: Use purple for actionable controls and selected appearance choices; use muted ink for supporting information.

rules.name: The Shared Panel Rule
rules.body: Reuse browser panel content inside desktop windows; embedded content fills its host without an extra outer radius or modal shadow.

rules.name: The Floating Depth Rule
rules.body: Use diffuse shadows for floating panels and avatar actions; separate ordinary settings content with tone and fine borders.

dos: Do preserve the actual model as the visual focus and use its supplied assets.
Do use the existing purple selected states and visible keyboard focus treatment.
Do keep chat and settings content consistent between browser and embedded desktop panels.
Do distinguish a model click from a drag, and preserve the reduced-motion override.
donts: Don't invent expression or outfit choices when the selected model has no matching assets.
Don't add opaque application chrome behind the transparent desktop avatar.
